answer_text:
Here are some funny, relatable, and genuinely weird habits that people have — you might even recognize a few of your own!

---

### 🖊️ 1. Doodling During Phone Calls
There are a handful of people who doodle during phone calls to help keep them focused — and sometimes they don't even know they're doing it until they're off the phone!

---

### 🗣️ 2. Talking to Inanimate Objects
A lot of people have the habit of talking to inanimate objects — like apologizing to a table after accidentally bumping into it, or yelling at a laptop when it freezes right in the middle of something important.

---

### 🚿 3. Rehearsing Arguments in the Shower
The shower seems to be the perfect place for people to rehearse arguments. It's frustrating how the most brilliant comebacks for past conflicts always seem to surface while shampooing your hair — long after the moment has passed.

---

### 🛋️ 4. Faking Sleep to Avoid Conversations
The moment some people hear footsteps approaching, they instantly fake sleep like they're in a coma. Whether trying to avoid an awkward conversation or just perfecting their acting skills, they suddenly transform into the deepest sleeper imaginable!

---

### 🗑️ 5. Folding Trash Neatly
Some people fold their trash — any pieces of paper, foil, chip bags, candy wrappers, or paper towels — folding everything into a neat square once they're done with the contents.

---

### 🥤 6. Tapping a Can Before Opening It
Some people tap the lid of a can three times before opening a Coke, beer, or other drink — without even knowing why or that they're doing it. When asked, they just go along with it being "for luck."

---

### 🐕 7. Telling Objects to "Stay"
Some people, every time they set down a breakable object or something they don't want to misplace, point at it and tell it to "stay" out loud — like you would a dog. They never thought it was weird until someone asked if they were afraid it would walk off.

---

### 🌙 8. Running After Turning Off the Lights
Some people bolt toward their room as soon as they switch off the hall light, convinced that something creepy will appear behind them — while others bravely switch off the light and walk slowly while singing loudly, as if hosting a concert for the ghosts.

---

### 📱 9. Scrolling Through Their Own Social Media
Some people scroll through their own Instagram or Facebook profiles as if they were their biggest fan — casually going through posts, checking the number of likes, and feeling like a celebrity reading the comments.

---

### 🥛 10. Shaking Store-Bought Milk
Some people shake milk jugs before pouring — a habit carried over from being raised on a dairy farm where it was necessary with fresh milk. It wasn't until around age 30 that one person realized they didn't need to do it with store-bought milk!

---

### 🧁 11. Eating Non-Food Items (Pica)
On the more extreme end, some people have a habit of eating non-food items like dirt or chalk, which is known as pica.

---

As humans, we're all odd in our own ways, but some of our tendencies are more common than you might think. So don't be embarrassed — chances are, someone else shares your quirk! 😄
